description: Whenever the numerical satisfiability procedure accepts, its input is the code of a shared quantifier-free matrix and the associated sentence has a table model of size at most \(\max(1,m+c)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.decideCode_sound (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ) (m n e : ℕ)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.decideCode c arities m n e = true) :
  ∃ φ,
    φ.IsQF ∧
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.formulaCode
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.signature c arities) Empty.elim φ =
          e ∧
        ∃ d < max 1 (m + c),
          ∃ T, Fin (d + 1) ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.sentence c arities φ
